design_philosophy: A calm, sacred-yet-modern design that feels emotionally safe, trustworthy, and premium. Supports both light and dark modes. Generous spacing and soft aesthetics reduce cognitive load. Reverent and spiritually grounded without kitschy or overly 'churchy' visuals. Prioritizes peace and clarity.

theming.implementation_note: Use semantic color tokens defined below. Implement with Tailwind dark: variant + theme provider (e.g. next-themes or React Context). All components must adapt automatically.

typography.import_instruction: Import Outfit, Figtree, and Cormorant Garamond from Google Fonts.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous, airy spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12). Critical for reducing anxiety and cognitive load. Prioritize white space over density.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards and buttons
layout_and_spacing.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-black/40 border border-white/20 dark:border-white/10

buttons.primary: py-4 px-8 rounded-full font-medium transition-all active:scale-[0.985]
buttons.sos: w-20 h-20 rounded-full shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center text-white font-semibold

components.cards: rounded-3xl border border-border bg-surface p-6 shadow-sm
components.emotion_chips: rounded-full px-5 py-2.5 text-sm border border-border hover:bg-primary/5 transition-colors
components.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 w-full bg-surface/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-border py-3

screens.onboarding: 11-step personalized flow with mascot 'Grace'. Soft transitions using framer-motion. Focus on emotional safety and personalization.
screens.home: Contextual greeting, horizontal emotion chips, prominent SOS button, daily devotional card, quick actions. Clean and breathing-friendly.
screens.meditate: Filterable scripture-guided meditations with emotion tags. Premium tag on locked content.
screens.prayer_library: Categorized prayers + AI Prayer Generator entry point.
screens.journal: Simple composer with mood tags. Clean list view of past entries.
screens.paywall: Premium features checklist, monthly/annual toggle, high-contrast primary CTA using paywall_premium color. Soft and invitational tone.

motion.page_transitions: Soft fade + gentle slide-up (duration: 0.35s) using framer-motion
motion.interactions: Subtle scale on press (scale: 0.985), hover lift on cards
motion.breathing_exercise: Smooth pulsing circle synced to 4-7-8 breathing pattern with text cues

images.audio_player_background: Abstract soft pastel blur (use Unsplash or generated)
images.devotional: Peaceful, reverent imagery (sunrise, nature, soft light)

instructions_to_developers: All color usage must come from the semantic tokens in this file (never hardcode hex values in components).
Every screen must feel light, airy, and emotionally safe. Avoid dense layouts.
Scripture text must always use 'Cormorant Garamond' for a reverent feel.
The mascot 'Grace' (brain holding Bible + cross) should appear consistently during onboarding with gentle expression changes.
Paywall must feel invitational and value-first — never aggressive or urgent.
Support both light and dark modes from day one using Tailwind dark: variant.
